item: The incoming backup's integrity walk reads the staged file in order first and maps it
summary: validate_sqlite_file reads the staged plaintext file once front to back (posix_fadvise SEQUENTIAL where available) and asks for a memory map (the stdlib caps it at 2 GiB) before the same PRAGMA quick_check. Measured in a sandbox at the field's file-to-memory ratio (4.06 GB file, 3 GB memory cap, reads capped at 150 MB/s and 1,500 IOPS): 660 s plain, 342 s with the map alone, 63 s with the read and the map. What is checked is unchanged; OO_VALIDATE_WARM=0 turns it off; the read pushes other files out of the OS cache, which is why only the import's staged copy gets it.
